_note: Single source of truth for native test envs; run test/gen_test_envs.py to regenerate platformio.ini.

native_canopen.desc:
CANopen (CiA 301) message codec (services/fieldbus/canopen): NMT, SYNC, heartbeat, EMCY,
PDO, and expedited SDO read/write/abort + the COB-ID classifier, over the shared CAN
frame (shared_primitives/can.h). Pure host tests.

native_cia402.desc:
CiA 402 / IEC 61800-7-201 drive profile (services/fieldbus/cia402): the Statusword power-state
decode (mask/value table), the Controlword commands + enable sequence, Statusword flags, the
CANopen SDO setters (Controlword / Modes / target position-velocity-torque) and cyclic PDO
pack/unpack. Layers on services/canopen. Pure host tests.

native_control.desc:
PID control law (services/system/control): the P/I/D terms, output clamping, anti-windup by
conditional integration, derivative-on-measurement (no setpoint kick) + optional low-pass,
feed-forward, the batched multi-axis update, and the inline control-law primitives (clamp /
deadband / slew / low-pass). Pure single-precision float; host tests.

native_dbm.desc:
Log-structured hash key-value store on the WAL (services/storage/dbm): put/get/delete with an
in-RAM open-addressed index and value data appended to the write-ahead log, plus index rebuild by
replaying the log on open. Pure host tests over a RAM-backed WalDev, incl. overwrite, tombstone
resurrection, persistence across a remount (with and without checkpoint), collisions, index-full
fail-closed, key/value bounds, and a max-size value round-trip.

native_docstore.desc:
Local JSON document store on the WAL (services/storage/docstore): JSON documents addressed by id,
stored via dbm on the write-ahead log, plus top-level field queries (find documents whose JSON field
equals a value) via the zero-heap JSON reader. Pure host tests over a RAM-backed WalDev, incl.
put/get/delete, string/int/bool field finds, persistence + query across a remount, and early stop.

native_dnc.desc:
CNC DNC drip-feed (services/machine_tool/dnc): the EIA RS-244 <-> ISO/ASCII tape-code translation
(odd-parity EIA table), ISO even parity, G-code block framing with '%' rewind-stop and leader
runout, XON/XOFF flow-control state, a streaming block reassembling decoder, and the dnc_stream
drip-feed engine (leader / markers / blocks over a send/recv seam, paced on reverse-channel
XON/XOFF). Pure host tests, incl. an odd-parity + exact-inverse table guardrail, full encode ->
decode program round-trips for both tape codes, and a scripted mock controller that decodes the
streamed program back and exercises the XOFF/XON pause-resume path.

native_ftp.desc:
FTP client wire codec (services/file_transfer/ftp, RFC 959 + RFC 2428): the control-command
builders (generic verb + PORT + EPRT), the single/multi-line 3-digit reply parser, and the
PASV / EPSV data-address decoders. Pure host tests with authentic reply strings captured from a
live FTP server (multiline greeting + FEAT, PASV/EPSV tuples).

native_httpcache.desc:
HTTP Cache-Control helpers (services/web/httpcache, RFC 9111 + 8246 + 5861): the
structured directive builder + first-class origin presets (immutable asset / shared / no-store /
revalidatable), the tolerant directive parser (case-insensitive, quoted deltas, unknown ignored),
and the RFC 9111 freshness-lifetime precedence. Pure host tests incl. a build->parse round-trip.

native_edge_cache.desc:
CDN edge-cache engine (services/web/edge_cache): the pure freshness/validator core (response
header-field access, HTTP-date parsing over IMF-fixdate / RFC 850 / asctime, RFC 9111 lifetime +
Expires-Date + heuristic + corrected age, the canonical cache key + SHA-256 digest + Vary secondary
key, and the L1 LRU/TTL store + storeability rules), plus the async origin-fetch engine (completion
detection over Content-Length / chunked / connection-close, and the state machine over a mock transport
seam), plus the shared single-range `Range: bytes=...` parser (http_parse_byte_range) that backs serving
206 Partial Content windows from a cached body. Pure host tests.

native_edge_cache_sd.desc:
CDN edge-cache L2 SD-persistence tier (services/web/edge_cache/edge_cache_sd): the entry <->
dbm-value serialization roundtrip (all response metadata, Vary variants, binary and max-size bodies),
the spill/promote/del/purge API over a dbm on a RAM-backed WalDev, the L1 store's on_evict write-back
hook, the storeability gates (no-validator and oversize entries stay L1-only), reboot survival via
remount + index replay, and that a shared dbm's foreign values are never touched. PC_DBM_VAL_MAX is
sized below a full entry so the oversize-stays-L1 path is exercised. Pure host tests.

native_edge_mesh.desc:
CDN edge-cache mesh sibling-cache codec (services/web/edge_cache/edge_mesh): the request/response
wire frames (build + tri-state accumulating parse over partial reads, magic/version/opcode validation),
the freshness-carrying entry frame (the shared edge_sd body plus a timing trailer) round-tripped
byte-exact, RFC 9111 age propagation (a peer's corrected age transfers so the receiver stays fresh for
the remaining lifetime and its Age keeps growing), and the async peer-query engine reaching HIT / MISS /
FAILED (timeout, peer close, malformed) over a scripted mock transport seam. Pure host tests.

native_primitives.desc:
Shared no-stdlib primitives (shared_primitives): the base-10 pc_strtol/strtoul/strtof
number parsers (numparse.h), the strict RFC 3629 UTF-8 validator (utf8.h), and the parameterized
Rocksoft/Williams CRC engine (crc.h). Every preset is asserted against its published cataloge check
value (the CRC of "123456789"), and the engine is then diffed against the hand-rolled CRC loops the
in-tree services used to carry - X-25, CCITT-FALSE, ARC, MODBUS, DNP, CRC-32, ESP3 CRC-8 and the
Sensirion CRC-8 - across every length 0..64. Those loops are interop-proven against real peers, so
the 13 services now calling the engine are proven byte-identical to the code they retired rather
than merely plausible; the transcriptions here are what still pins that behaviour. Plus the streaming
split, the reflect flags, width masking, and single-bit-flip detection. Header-only; pure host tests.

native_ip.desc:
IP address core (network_drivers/network/pc_ip): RFC 4291 IPv4/IPv6 text parsing,
RFC 5952 canonical formatting (:: zero-compression, v4-mapped), and scope classification
(loopback / link-local / private-ULA / multicast / global). Pure host tests.

native_arena.desc:
Unified double-ended server arena (network_drivers/session/pc_arena): first-fit
persistent end (bottom, individual free + coalesce + boundary shrink) + bump scratch end
(top, mark/release/reset) sharing a floating middle; fail-closed at the boundary. Host tests.

native_ssh_ed25519.desc:
Modern SSH crypto KATs (curve25519-sha256 KEX + ssh-ed25519 host key / client auth):
SHA-512 (FIPS 180-4), X25519 (RFC 7748), Ed25519 (RFC 8032). Vectors are the published RFC
test vectors + tool-generated digests, grounding the impl against the standards. Pure host tests.

native_ssh_inflate.desc:
SSH client-to-server resumable INFLATE (ssh_inflate): decompresses OpenSSH's per-packet
Z_PARTIAL_FLUSH zlib stream across packets with a 32 KB context-takeover window. Verified against
golden vectors produced by real zlib (windowBits 15, Z_PARTIAL_FLUSH per packet; tools/gen_ssh_inflate_vectors.py),
covering fixed/dynamic/stored blocks, cross-packet back-references, and empty/tiny payloads. Pure host tests.

native_crypto_kat.desc:
Data-driven external crypto known-answer tests: HMAC-SHA256/512, AEAD_AES_128_GCM,
X25519, and Ed25519 verify from Project Wycheproof (including its adversarial edge cases),
plus HKDF-SHA256 Extract (RFC 5869), the ChaCha20 block (RFC 8439 2.4.2), and Poly1305
(RFC 8439 2.5.2). Vectors are vendored as auditable JSON (test/vectors) and compiled to a
table by tools/gen_crypto_vectors.py. Pure host tests.

native_promisc.desc:
Wi-Fi promiscuous capture helpers (services/radio/promisc): the pure 802.11 MAC header parser
(to/from-DS src/dst/bssid resolution, QoS, WDS 4-address, control frames, malformed
rejection) and libpcap (DLT_IEEE802_11) framing. Pure host tests.

native_bus_capture.desc:
CAN listen-only capture framing (server/signaling/bus_capture): can_to_socketcan() building the
16-byte Linux SocketCAN frame (big-endian can_id, EFF/RTR flags, length, data) and the
DLT_CAN_SOCKETCAN libpcap link type. Pure host tests.

native_j1939.desc:
SAE J1939 codec (services/fieldbus/j1939): 29-bit id encode/decode (PDU1 + PDU2), single-frame
messages, Request PGN, Address Claimed + NAME, and the Transport Protocol (BAM + TP.DT)
reassembler, over the shared CAN frame. Pure host tests.

native_devicenet.desc:
DeviceNet link-adaptation codec (services/fieldbus/devicenet): the 4-group 11-bit CAN id,
explicit-message header octet, single-frame explicit messages, and the fragmentation
reassembler (CIP over CAN; the CIP body is built with the cip codec). Pure host tests.

native_nmea2000.desc:
NMEA 2000 codec (services/timing_position/nmea2000): single-frame messages plus the Fast Packet
transport (frame count, build, reassembly), built on the J1939 id codec (implied). Pure
host tests.

native_mbus.desc:
Wired M-Bus codec (services/fieldbus/mbus): the ACK / short / long frame builders + parser
(start/stop, doubled length, 8-bit sum checksum) and the EN 13757-3 variable-data record
walker (DIF/VIF, DIFE/VIFE chains, LVAR). Pure host tests.

native_iec60870.desc:
IEC 60870-5-101/-104 codec (services/energy/iec60870): the -104 APCI (I/S/U), the ASDU
header + 3-octet IOA, and the -101 FT1.2 fixed/variable link frames (sum checksum). Pure
host tests.

native_sdi12.desc:
SDI-12 sensor-bus codec (services/peripherals/sdi12): the command builders, the measurement
response parser (atttn), the data-value splitter, and the SDI-12 CRC (compute/encode/verify).
Pure host tests.

native_dmx.desc:
DMX512 + RDM lighting codec (services/peripherals/dmx): the DMX512 slot packet (build/get) and the
RDM (ANSI E1.20) packet build/parse with 48-bit UIDs and the 16-bit additive checksum. Pure
host tests.

native_nmea0183.desc:
NMEA 0183 sentence codec (services/timing_position/nmea0183): the XOR checksum, sentence build, parse
(field splitting, talker/type, checksum validation) against the canonical GGA vector, and the
field-value helpers. Pure host tests.

native_ubx.desc:
UBX (u-blox binary GNSS protocol) codec (services/timing_position/ubx): B5 62 framing, 8-bit Fletcher checksum,
build/poll/parse, and the streaming NMEA+UBX demultiplexer. KATs are the published MON-VER /
CFG-PRT poll frames. Pure host tests.

native_ptp.desc:
PTP / IEEE 1588-2008 (PTPv2) message codec + slave clock math (network_drivers/application/ptp): the 34-octet common
header, 10-octet timestamp, Sync/Delay_Req/Follow_Up/Delay_Resp/Announce build+parse, and the
offset/mean-path-delay calculation from t1..t4. Pure host tests.

native_roaming.desc:
Wi-Fi roaming decision layer (network_drivers/network/roaming): the pure policy that fuses the current RSSI, a
candidate neighbour list, and an optional 802.11v BTM hint into a roam/stay decision (target BSSID +
channel + reason), with a hysteresis margin and a disassoc-imminent override. Pure host tests.

native_iolink.desc:
IO-Link (SDCI) data-link message codec (services/fieldbus/iolink): the MC / CKT / CKS control
octets and the SDCI checksum (seed 0x52 + the 8->6 compression of IO-Link spec A.1.6), with a
hand-computed known-answer vector. Pure host tests.

native_stack_l46.desc:
Layers 4-6 stack: transport + session + presentation + the standalone parser, no app layer. Base env for the suites that build on it; it runs no suite of its own.
These suites predate the RFC 7230 §5.4 Host rule and feed bare HTTP/1.1
request lines to exercise parser mechanics; Host enforcement is verified
separately in env:native_compliance.

native_observability.desc:
Transport observability (PC_ENABLE_OBSERVABILITY): the pc_conn_on_event
hook, by-reason counters, the live CONN_CLOSING gauge, and that the real lwIP
callbacks (recv FIN / error / timeout / local close / backpressure) drive the
right counter. Pure L4 core - host-tested.

native_base64_scalar.desc:
base64 scalar constant-time decode fallback (PC_BASE64_SWAR=0): classify one character at a
time instead of the default SWAR four-per-word path. Runs the same RFC 4648 vectors, both alphabets,
malformed-input rejection, capacity guard, and round-trip fuzz as the SWAR path (covered by the same
test_base64 in env:native, where SWAR is the default) - proving the two decoders are byte-identical.

native_diffserv.desc:
DiffServ QoS marking (PC_ENABLE_DIFFSERV): the DSCP->TOS encode (DSCP << 2, ECN 0),
the server-wide and UDP DSCP defaults (set/get, 6-bit mask), the per-connection setter
(pc_conn_set_dscp writes pcb->tos on the host path), and the per-listener override
(pc_listen_set_dscp incl. the UNSET sentinel + mask + unknown-port miss). Compiles the
flag-guarded transport paths no other env builds. Pure L4 core - host-tested.

native_accept_gate.desc:
Accept-time connection gates with their flags ON (PC_ENABLE_ACCEPT_THROTTLE
/ PER_IP_THROTTLE / IP_ALLOWLIST): the global fixed-window throttle, the per-source-IP
bucket table (independent budgets, window rollover, the millis() wrap, bounded LRU
eviction), and the CIDR source-IP allowlist. Compiles the flag-guarded accept-callback
paths that no other env builds. Budgets overridden small so the boundaries are explicit.

native_ota.desc:
Parser streaming-body hook (OTA) - exercises http_parser with PC_ENABLE_OTA=1
using a mock sink (no ESP32 Update dependency).

native_prov.desc:
Provisioning form-field parser - the only host-testable part of the captive
portal (softAP / lwIP UDP / NVS are ESP32-only and compiled out here).

native_ssh.desc: SSH crypto layer (native software paths only, no mbedtls dependency); channels multiplexed (PC_SSH_MAX_CHANNELS=3) to exercise routing; SFTP/SCP subsystem routing on (MNT satisfies the guard - the file-transfer servers reach storage through the mount, not through FILE_SERVING)

native_ssh_kbdint.desc: SSH keyboard-interactive auth (RFC 4256) built with PC_ENABLE_SSH_KEYBOARD_INTERACTIVE=1: the server sends one non-echoed Password prompt (INFO_REQUEST) and verifies the INFO_RESPONSE via the password callback. Also re-runs test_ssh_auth to confirm the password/publickey methods are unaffected with keyboard-interactive advertised.

native_ssh_pqc.desc:
mlkem768x25519-sha256 SSH hybrid KEX (draft-ietf-sshm-mlkem-hybrid-kex) end to end: the
full SSH transport built with PC_ENABLE_PQC_KEX=1 plus the ML-KEM-768 / SHA-3 core. Verifies the
hybrid is negotiated, then runs a real server-side key exchange and checks it as a conforming client
would - ML-KEM Decaps (an independent reference) + X25519, K = SHA256(K_PQ || K_CL), the string-K
exchange hash and KDF, and the ed25519 signature over H.

native_ssh_hardened.desc: SSH built with password auth disabled (publickey-only hardening)

native_ssh_conn.desc: SSH wired through the real transport/session layers (PROTO_SSH byte-pump)

native_ssh_sftp.desc:
SFTP protocol v3 wire codec (network_drivers/application/sftp): the SSH_FXP_* request reader + response builders
(VERSION / STATUS / HANDLE / DATA / ATTRS / NAME), the ATTRS blob encode/decode round-trip (size / perms /
mtime + the flag word, skipping unknown/extended fields), packet length-framing (need-more vs
malformed/too-big), and the ls -l longname formatter. Pure host tests (no fs / no SSH).

native_scp.desc:
SCP (RCP) protocol wire codec (network_drivers/application/scp): parse an `scp -t/-f <path>` exec command into its
sink/source role + target, parse + build the `C<mode> <size> <name>` control line (octal mode, decimal
size, name; malformed lines rejected), and the ack byte constants. Pure host tests.

native_stack_http.desc: Full HTTP/1.1 server stack through Layer 7. Base env for the suites that build on it; it runs no suite of its own.

native_webdav_handler.desc: WebDAV request handler over a directory-capable FS mock (recursive COPY/MOVE/DELETE)

native_diag.desc:
Build-flag reporter (diag() / PC_ENABLE_DIAG). The gated diag() entry point
and its DIAG_DOC frame spec are enabled by no other env, so this one keeps them
compiled + exercised in CI. Reuses the full app src via the native_stack_http
base.

native_snmp.desc:
SNMP ASN.1 BER codec (the version-agnostic base for the SNMP agent). Pure
codec - no lwIP/UDP - so it unit-tests on the host.

native_snmp_v3.desc:
SNMPv3 USM layer: auth (HMAC-SHA-256), privacy (AES-128-CFB), engine discovery,
timeliness. Pulls in the SHA-256/HMAC primitives from the SSH crypto layer.

native_telnet.desc:
Telnet server (RFC 854 IAC negotiation + line editing) wired through the real
transport ring buffer; output checked via the tcp_write capture mock.

native_coap.desc:
CoAP server (RFC 7252) message codec + resource dispatch. Pure core - no
lwIP/UDP - so it unit-tests on the host (udp_transport provides host stubs).

native_coap_observe.desc:
CoAP with resource observation (RFC 7641) enabled. Compiles + runs test_coap
with PC_ENABLE_COAP_OBSERVE on, so the Observe-gated code (request Observe
recording, the observer registry, pc_coap_notify) is actually built in CI instead
of bit-rotting (it is enabled by no other env).

native_webdav.desc:
WebDAV server core (RFC 4918): method classification, header parsing, XML
escaping, and the 207 Multi-Status builder. Pure core - no FS/sockets - so it
unit-tests on the host. The FS-backed handling is HW-tested on a real LittleFS.

native_modbus.desc:
Modbus TCP slave core + RTU framing (Modbus Application Protocol): the data
model + MBAP/PDU codec + the RTU ADU codec (CRC16 + [addr][PDU][CRC]). Pure core
- the transports are ARDUINO-gated - so it unit-tests on the host from modbus.cpp alone.

native_cloudevents.desc:
CloudEvents v1.0 envelope (services/iot/cloudevents): the structured-JSON builder
(over the JSON writer) + the binary-mode ce-* header reader. Pure host tests.

native_redis.desc:
Redis RESP2/RESP3 codec (services/iot/redis_resp): the zero-heap command encoder + the
cursor reply parser (RESP2 simple/error/integer/bulk/array/nil plus RESP3 null/boolean/double/big
number/bulk error/verbatim/map/set/push). Pure host tests against Redis spec vectors.

native_sqlite.desc:
SQLite3 on-disk file-format reader (services/storage/sqlite): the 100-byte database header, the
b-tree page header, the record varint, and record serial types, parsed by hand. Pure host tests
against a real database built by the sqlite3 CLI (page-1 header + b-tree header + first-cell varints)
plus varint and serial-type spec vectors.

native_stomp.desc:
STOMP 1.2 frame codec (services/iot/stomp): the zero-heap frame builder (command +
escaped headers + NUL body) + the non-mutating parser (command/header slices/body,
honoring content-length) + escape/unescape. Pure host tests.

native_mqtt_sn.desc:
MQTT-SN v1.2 wire codec (services/iot/mqtt/mqtt_sn): the zero-heap message builders
(CONNECT/REGISTER/PUBLISH/SUBSCRIBE/PINGREQ/DISCONNECT/SEARCHGW) + the Length+MsgType
header parser (1- and 3-octet forms) + typed payload parsers. Pure host tests.

native_flow_export.desc:
Flow-record export codec (services/net/flow_export): NetFlow v5 fixed header/record
builders + the NetFlow v9 / IPFIX template-then-data cursor (length/count patching,
v9 4-octet padding). Pure host tests with wire-byte assertions.

native_protobuf.desc:
Protocol Buffers wire codec (services/iot/protobuf): the zero-heap streaming writer
(varint / ZigZag / fixed32 / fixed64 / length-delimited) + the cursor reader, host-tested
against the spec vectors. Pure host tests.

native_preempt_queue.desc:
Preempting work queue (services/system/preempt_queue), v5 real-time ingest: the host
fixed-ring core - FIFO order, urgent-to-front, fail-closed when full, high-water,
and drain/handler dispatch. The ARDUINO FreeRTOS task + ISR post + preempt latency
are HW-verified separately (the host has no tasks/ISRs).

native_dma.desc:
DMA peripheral ingest / egress simulator (mmgr/dma), v5 hardware ingest: an
ingress feed surfaces as RX completion events, a full buffer ping-pongs and re-arms,
egress DMA is captured, TX is one-in-flight fail-closed, and a loopback channel
round-trips its own TX into RX. The ARDUINO ISR-post + preempt-queue hand-off is
HW-verified separately (the host has no ISRs).

native_trace_capture.desc:
Pre/post-trigger sample-window assembler (server/signaling/trace_capture), v5 high-rate
acquisition: a continuously-running pre-trigger ring, trigger() freezing it as the window's
pre-trigger half, feed() filling the post-trigger half and firing the sink on completion,
one capture in flight fail-closed (dropped triggers counted), samples fed before begin() /
after end() counted dropped, and multiple sequential windows with a correct trace_id
sequence. Pure host tests (pc_cycles() falls back to a coarse host stand-in; only ordering,
not magnitude, is asserted for assembly_cycles).

native_ad9238.desc:
AD9238 SPI configuration-port codec (services/peripherals/ad9238): the 16-bit instruction word
(R/W + byte-count + 13-bit address) for single-byte register writes/reads, the device-update
transfer transaction, and the input-validation fail-closed paths (null buffer, undersized
cap, zero/oversize byte count, out-of-range address). Pure host tests - the SPI clocking and
the per-register bit-field meanings are the datasheet's / the application's, not this codec's.

native_forward.desc:
Interface forwarding plane (services/net/forward), v5 bridge / router: default-deny,
an ALLOW rule forwards, a DENY wins, multi-destination fan-out, no reflection to the
source, the per-rule rate cap (host test clock), send-failure counting, the interface /
rule table limits, the ingress ACL (byte-pattern permit/deny, first-match, default
action), policy routing (byte-pattern -> egress, precedence + fail-closed), and the opt-in
inspection hook. Pure host tests; the DMA-driven wiring is HW-verified.

native_gateway.desc:
Radio / wireless gateway bridge (services/net/gateway), v5 southbound-to-northbound: an
uplink envelopes a received frame (src address / port / rssi / seq) and publishes it,
fail-closed on no sink / unknown port / rate cap / sink refusal; a downlink routes to the
port transmit callback; the topic helper formats <prefix>/<port>/<addr>; port table limits.
Pure host tests; the DMA + FORWARD-lane ingest is HW-verified separately.

native_lora.desc:
LoRa codec + SX127x driver (services/radio/lora), v5 radio plugin: the RadioHead 4-byte
header parse/build, and the SX127x register protocol (init / send / tx-done / set-rx /
recv) exercised against a mock chip - a register file plus a FIFO with the auto-
incrementing address pointer. Pure host tests; the RF link needs the module.

native_nrf24.desc:
nRF24L01+ driver (services/radio/nrf24), v5 radio plugin: the Nordic SPI command protocol
(STATUS shifted out first, W/R_REGISTER, W_TX/R_RX_PAYLOAD, write-1-to-clear) exercised
against a mock chip - init / send (padded to the static width) / tx-done / set-rx / recv
(pipe-addressed). Pure host tests; the RF link needs the module.

native_enocean.desc:
EnOcean ESP3 serial codec (services/radio/enocean), v5 radio plugin: the CRC-8 (poly 0x07)
against known answers, a build -> parse round trip, malformed framing (bad sync / header
CRC / data CRC), incomplete telegrams, over-length rejection, and resynchronisation.
Pure host tests.

native_pn532.desc:
PN532 NFC frame codec (services/peripherals/pn532), v5 radio plugin: the normal-information-frame
build/parse against the documented GetFirmwareVersion command + response frames (LEN/LCS +
DCS checksums), a round trip, malformed framing (bad preamble / start / LCS / DCS), the ACK
frame, and over-length rejection. Pure host tests.

native_sigfox.desc:
Sigfox modem AT-command codec (services/radio/sigfox), v5 radio plugin: the AT$SF uplink
command (uppercase hex encoding of the payload), its bounds (12-byte cap, output cap), and
the OK / ERROR / PENDING response classification. Pure host tests.

native_zwave.desc:
Z-Wave Serial API frame codec (services/radio/zwave), v5 radio plugin: the data-frame
build/parse against the documented GetVersion request (01 03 00 15 E9), the XOR checksum, a
round trip, malformed framing (bad SOF / checksum / length), incomplete frames, and the ACK
/ NAK / CAN control bytes. Pure host tests.

native_zigbee.desc:
Zigbee EZSP / ASH framing codec (services/radio/zigbee), v5 radio plugin: the CRC-16/CCITT
and the encoded RST frame against their documented values (C0 38 BC 7E), an encode -> decode
round trip, the byte-stuffing of reserved bytes, and malformed framing (bad CRC, dangling
escape, buffer-too-small, no flag). Pure host tests.

native_thread.desc:
Thread spinel / HDLC-lite codec (services/radio/thread), v5 radio plugin: the FCS
(CRC-16/X-25) against its catalog check value (0x906E), an encode -> decode round trip, the
byte-stuffing of reserved bytes, malformed framing (bad FCS, dangling escape,
buffer-too-small, no flag), the spinel command layer (packed-uint KATs, command build/parse
through HDLC), and the property registry + typed value semantics (reader/writer round trip
across every spinel datatype, little-endian wire layout, PROTOCOL_VERSION / CAPS decode,
UTF8 + length-prefixed data, bounds/overflow latching, prop + status name lookup). Pure host tests.

native_udp_transport.desc:
UDP transport multicast receive (network_drivers/transport/udp.cpp): joining an IPv4
multicast group by dotted-quad, rejecting a non-multicast or malformed group, delivering a group
datagram to the registered handler, and leaving the group (releasing the listener slot). Drives the
host UDP mock's inject seam.

native_wamp.desc:
WAMP messaging codec (services/iot/wamp): the JSON-array message builders (HELLO /
SUBSCRIBE / PUBLISH / CALL / REGISTER / YIELD / GOODBYE over JsonWriter) + the positional
array parser (type / ids / URIs, nesting-aware). Pure host tests.

native_sunspec.desc:
SunSpec Modbus model codec (services/energy/sunspec): the map writer (marker / model
headers / points / end model) + the model-chain walker + typed point readers
(u16 / i16 / u32 / i32 / string). Pure host tests.

native_c37118.desc:
IEEE C37.118.2 synchrophasor frame codec (services/energy/c37118): CRC-CCITT, the frame
builder + Command frame, and the CRC-validating parser (type / ids / timestamp / payload).
Pure host tests.

native_dnp3.desc:
DNP3 (IEEE 1815) data-link frame codec (services/energy/dnp3): CRC-16/DNP, the frame
builder (0x0564 header + CRC'd 16-octet data blocks) and the CRC-validating, de-blocking
parser. Pure host tests.

native_grpcweb.desc:
gRPC-Web message framing codec (services/iot/grpcweb): the 5-octet length-prefixed
message frame builder + the 0x80 trailers frame (grpc-status / grpc-message) + the frame
parser. Pure host tests.

native_lwm2m_tlv.desc:
OMA LwM2M TLV codec (services/iot/lwm2m): the writer (raw + int / bool / string /
float value helpers, 8-/16-bit ids, inline / 8-/16-/24-bit lengths) + the cursor reader
+ integer value decoding. Pure host tests.

native_fins.desc:
Omron FINS frame codec (services/fieldbus/fins): the command builder + Memory Area Read
convenience + the command / response parsers (10-octet header, MRC/SRC, MRES/SRES end
code). Pure host tests.

native_hostlink.desc:
Omron Host Link (C-mode) frame codec (services/fieldbus/hostlink): the FCS (XOR), the ASCII
command builder (@UU + header + text + FCS + *CR), and the FCS-validating parser +
end-code reader. Pure host tests.

native_scpi.desc:
SCPI / IEEE 488.2 instrument-control codec (services/instrumentation/scpi): the command builder
(:-hierarchy header + params + terminator), the response parsers (numeric NR1/NR2/NR3,
boolean, quoted string, definite/indefinite arbitrary block), the STB/ESR/ESE/SRE +
error-queue status model, and the SCPI short/long-form header matcher. Pure host tests.

native_hislip.desc:
HiSLIP (High-Speed LAN Instrument Protocol, IVI-6.1) message codec (services/instrumentation/hislip):
the fixed 16-byte header build/parse (HS prologue + type + control + 32-bit param + 64-bit
payload length, big-endian), the Initialize / AsyncInitialize handshake helpers, and the
Data / DataEND SCPI-payload framing with message ids. Pure host tests.

native_vxi11.desc:
VXI-11 (TCP/IP Instrument Protocol) codec over ONC RPC / XDR (services/instrumentation/vxi11): the XDR
write/read helpers (4-byte-aligned, big-endian, length-prefixed opaque/string), the ONC-RPC
record-marking + CALL/REPLY framing with AUTH_NONE, the portmapper GETPORT call, and the
DEVICE_CORE procedures (create_link / device_write / device_read / device_readstb /
destroy_link). Pure host tests with byte-exact vectors.

native_gpib.desc:
GPIB-over-LAN (Prologix-style) controller command codec (services/instrumentation/gpib): the ++ command
builders (addr / mode / read / eoi / eos / spoll / clr / trg / ver), the data-line escaping
(leading ESC before CR/LF/ESC/+ in instrument data), the command-vs-data classifier, and the
response parsers (address, serial-poll status byte, version). Pure host tests.

native_haas_mdc.desc:
Haas Machine Data Collection (MDC) Q-command codec (services/machine_tool/haas_mdc): the ?Q query
builders (Q100 serial, Q101 software version, Q102 model, Q104 mode, Q300 power-on time, Q500
program + run status + parts counter, Q600 <var> macro/system-variable read) and the parser for the
>-wrapped comma-delimited responses plus the unprompted DPRNT(...) lines. Pure host tests.

native_packml.desc:
PackML / OMAC packaging-machine state model (services/machine_tool/packml), ISA-TR88.00.02: the pure
17-state transition engine (command / state-complete / execute-complete + command validity) and the
owned PackTags service (state advance, production counters, unit-mode rules, machine speed, and the
state/reset timers). Pure host tests.

native_lsv2.desc:
Heidenhain LSV/2 telegram codec (services/machine_tool/lsv2): the framer (4-byte big-endian payload-length
prefix + 4-char mnemonic + payload), the typed request builders (login A_LG / logout A_LO,
null-terminated-filename file commands, R_RI run-info with a 2-byte big-endian selector), and the
response readers (T_OK, the T_ER/T_BD 2-byte error-class + error-code, data replies, stream
re-framing). Byte-exact vectors cross-checked against pyLSV2. Pure host tests.

native_ikev2.desc:
IKEv2 (RFC 7296) message + payload codec (services/security/ikev2): the 28-octet IKE header, the generic
payload chain walker, the SA -> proposal -> transform tree (incl. the key-length attribute), and the
KE / Nonce / Notify / Delete / IDi-IDr / AUTH / CERT / TSi-TSr / SK-envelope build + parse. Byte-exact
golden vectors generated by scapy's IKEv2 codec (key-length attribute verified against scapy's
decoder). Pure host tests.

native_esp.desc:
ESP (RFC 4303) packet transform with AES-256-GCM (RFC 4106) - the IPsec datapath crypto core
(services/system/esp): encapsulate a payload into SPI|Seq|IV|AES-GCM(payload|pad|padlen|nexthdr)|ICV and
verify + decapsulate it, with the SPI|Seq AAD + salt||IV nonce. Gated on the IKEv2 feature. Pure host
tests cross-checked against a Python AES-256-GCM reference.

native_ipsec_db.desc:
IPsec Security Policy Database + Security Association Database (RFC 4301, services/system/esp/ipsec_db):
ordered first-match-wins SPD policy lookup over source/destination/protocol/port selector ranges,
an SPD selector built from an IKEv2-negotiated TSi/TSr pair, and SPI-keyed SAD add/find/remove with
per-SA outbound sequence allocation + inbound anti-replay window. Pure host-testable datapath logic.

native_senml.desc:
SenML (RFC 8428) pack builder (services/iot/senml): the SenML-JSON encoder (over the
JSON writer) + the SenML-CBOR encoder (over the CBOR writer, integer labels), integral
numbers emitted as integers. Pure host tests.

native_df1.desc:
Allen-Bradley DF1 full-duplex frame codec (services/fieldbus/df1): BCC + CRC-16/ARC, the
frame builder with DLE byte-stuffing, and the validating, un-stuffing parser. Vectors from
AB pub. 1770-6.5.16. Pure host tests.

native_simatic.desc:
Siemens SIMATIC serial (services/fieldbus/simatic): 3964R block framing (DLE-double + XOR BCC)
+ the 3964R link state machine (STX/DLE handshake, NAK/QVZ retry, ZVZ timeout, priority
arbitration) + RK512 SEND/FETCH/reaction telegram build/parse (big-endian words). Pure host tests.

native_cotp.desc:
TPKT (RFC 1006) + COTP X.224 class-0 frame codec (services/fieldbus/cotp): the TPKT
envelope, the COTP Data TPDU + Connection Request builders, and the COTP parser. The
ISO-on-TCP foundation under S7comm / IEC 61850 MMS. Pure host tests.

native_s7comm.desc:
Siemens S7comm PDU codec (services/fieldbus/s7comm): the Setup Communication + Read Var
request builders, the header parser, and the response data-item reader (length-in-bits +
even padding). Constants per the Wireshark dissector. Pure host tests.

native_melsec.desc:
Mitsubishi MELSEC MC binary 3E codec (services/fieldbus/melsec): the batch-read request
builder (little-endian, subheader 0x5000, command 0x0401, device code + 24-bit head device)
+ the 0xD000 response parser. Pure host tests.

native_ads.desc:
Beckhoff ADS / AMS codec (services/fieldbus/ads): the AMS/TCP + AMS-header request builders
(little-endian, target-before-source addressing, cmd id + state flags + cbData + invoke id) for
Read/Write/ReadWrite/ReadState/ReadDeviceInfo/WriteControl/Add+DeleteNotification + the response
parsers incl. the DeviceNotification stamp/sample walk. TwinCAT PC-based control. Pure host tests.

native_focas.desc:
FANUC FOCAS Ethernet codec (services/machine_tool/focas): the big-endian frame envelope
(magic/version/type/length) + open/close handshake, the generic command request (6-octet function
selector + five i32 args), and the response parsers (echoed selector + FOCAS return code + data),
incl. ODBSYS SysInfo, the alarm bitmask, and the 8-octet data/base^exp value encoding. FANUC CNC
data over TCP 8193, reverse-engineered vs diohpix/pyfanuc. Pure host tests.

native_fanuc_j519.desc:
FANUC Stream Motion / option J519 UDP codec (services/machine_tool/fanuc_j519): the robot
counterpart to FOCAS. The 8-octet little-endian header, all six packets (Start/Motion/Stop/Request
PC->robot, Robot Status/Ack robot->PC), the 9-axis IEEE-754 binary32 pose/joint/current blocks, and
the 20-entry threshold tables - byte-checked at every field offset against the public Wireshark
dissector, plus symmetric build->parse round trips. Includes the length guards that separate the two
packets sharing a type code per direction (Start 8 vs Status 132, Request 16 vs Ack 184). No heap,
no stdlib. Pure host tests.

native_pqc.desc:
Post-quantum hybrid KEX primitives (network_drivers/presentation/pqc): the
Keccak/SHA-3/SHAKE sponge (FIPS 202) and ML-KEM-768 Encaps (FIPS 203) - the responder half of the
mlkem768x25519-sha256 (SSH) and X25519MLKEM768 (TLS 1.3) hybrid key exchanges - plus the full
Streamlined NTRU Prime sntrup761 KEM (keypair/enc/dec) for sntrup761x25519-sha512@openssh.com.
SHA-3/SHAKE digests pinned from NIST FIPS 202 vectors; ML-KEM Encaps byte-checked against a kyber-py
vector; sntrup761 decapsulation checked against an OpenSSH-reference KAT plus a keypair/enc/dec
round-trip. Pure host tests.

native_iface_bridge.desc:
Interface bridge pure core (services/net/iface_bridge): the user-defined address:port -> bus
rule table (register / find / dedup / capacity, keyed by port+proto with the full pc_ip bind address
preserved) and the write-then-read transaction frame codec (big-endian write_len/read_len header,
partial-frame handling, build/parse round-trip). Bus I/O + listener are ESP32-only. Pure host tests.

native_rtcm3.desc:
RTCM 3.x framing + station-reference codec (services/timing_position/gnss/rtcm3), the pure core of the
GNSS RTK base / NTRIP caster: the transport frame (0xD3 preamble, 10-bit length, CRC-24Q), MSB-first
bit I/O, and 1005/1006 Stationary Antenna Reference Point encode/decode. Frames verified byte-for-byte
against pyrtcm. Pure host tests.

native_gnss_survey.desc:
GNSS survey-in core (services/timing_position/gnss/gnss_survey): the exact WGS84 geodetic<->ECEF
transform (matched against pyproj EPSG:4979->EPSG:4978), the shifted-origin position averager with a
3-D accuracy estimate, and the GGA->geodetic fold. Pure host tests.

native_ntrip_caster.desc:
NTRIP caster protocol codec (services/timing_position/gnss/ntrip_caster): rover request parsing
(mountpoint, NTRIP 1.0/2.0 version, HTTP Basic auth), the stream-accept / error responses, and the RTCM
source table (STR records + ENDSOURCETABLE with a self-consistent Content-Length). Pure host tests.

native_bacnet.desc:
BACnet/IP BVLC + NPDU codec (services/fieldbus/bacnet): the BVLC envelope (type 0x81,
function, length) + the NPDU header (version + NPCI control + optional DNET/DADR + hop
count) builders and parsers, slicing the APDU. ASHRAE 135. Pure host tests.

native_enip.desc:
EtherNet/IP encapsulation codec (services/fieldbus/enip): the 24-octet header, RegisterSession
+ SendRRData builders (Common Packet Format), and the SendRRData reply extractor. Constants
per the Wireshark ENIP dissector. Pure host tests.

native_amqp.desc:
AMQP 0-9-1 frame codec (services/iot/amqp): the protocol header, the frame + method
builders, the heartbeat, and the frame/method parsers (type/channel/size/payload/0xCE).
Pure host tests.

native_cip.desc:
CIP message codec (services/fieldbus/cip): the EPATH logical-segment builder, the request
builders (Get_Attribute_Single), and the response parser (service / status / data). Rides
an EtherNet/IP Unconnected Data item. Pure host tests.

native_nats.desc:
NATS client protocol codec (services/iot/nats): the CONNECT / PUB / SUB / UNSUB / PING /
PONG builders + the inbound MSG / INFO / PING / +OK / -ERR parser (subject/sid/reply/payload).
Pure host tests.

native_proxy_protocol.desc:
HAProxy PROXY protocol codec (services/net/proxy_protocol): the v1 (text) + v2 (binary)
TCP/IPv4 header builders and the unified parser (recover the real client IP behind a load
balancer). Pure host tests.

native_sparkplug.desc:
Sparkplug B codec (services/iot/sparkplug): the topic builder + the Metric / Payload
protobuf serializers (over the protobuf codec). Field numbers per the Eclipse Tahu proto.
Pure host tests.

native_modbus_master.desc:
Modbus master codec + scanner (services/fieldbus/modbus/modbus_master): build read
requests, parse responses; host-tested as a round-trip against the slave codec.

native_ota_rollback.desc:
OTA rollback decision (server/update/ota_rollback): pure decision matrix host-tested;
the esp_ota commit/rollback are ESP32-only.

native_totp.desc:
TOTP two-factor (services/security/totp): HMAC-SHA1 HOTP/TOTP + base32, host-tested
against the RFC 6238 vectors (builds on the software SHA-1).

native_webhook.desc:
Webhook / IFTTT builders (services/net/webhook): IFTTT URL + value1/2/3 JSON payload,
host-tested. Firing is via the http_client (ESP32).

native_radio_power.desc:
WiFi radio power controls (network_drivers/physical/radio_power): modem-sleep mode names
host-tested; the apply/readback are ESP32-only (esp_wifi).

native_dns_resolver.desc:
DNS resolver answer classifier/verifier (network_drivers/network/dns_resolver): host-tested;
the lwIP resolve is ESP32-only.

native_audit_log.desc:
Tamper-evident hash-chained audit log (services/security/audit_log). Pure - the chain is
identical on host and ESP32 - so it unit-tests on the host; SHA-256 comes from
crypto/sha256 (software path on native), the timestamp from the pluggable clock.

native_oidc.desc:
OIDC RS256 ID-token verifier (services/security/oidc). Pure relying-party verification -
the signature check is real RSA modexp (ssh_rsa + ssh_bignum), so it host-tests
against openssl-signed RS256 vectors with the matching JWKS public key.

native_graphql.desc:
GraphQL query subset (services/iot/graphql) - pure parser + executor, host-tested
with a demo resolver. No heap; bounds are compile-time.

native_espnow.desc:
ESP-NOW peer messaging (services/radio/espnow) - the envelope codec + peer registry
are host-tested here; the esp_now radio binding is ESP32-only. No heap.

native_oauth2.desc:
OAuth2 token-endpoint client (services/security/oauth2) - the form-body builder + JSON
token-response parser are host-tested (the parser reuses the JSON reader); the
HTTP exchange is ESP32-only. No heap, no stdlib.

native_opcua.desc:
OPC UA Binary increment 1 (services/fieldbus/opcua) - the type codec, UACP framing, and
Hello/Acknowledge handshake are host-tested here; the TCP server (opcua_rx) is
ESP32-only. No heap, no stdlib.

native_umati.desc:
umati / OPC UA for Machine Tools (OPC 40501-1) MachineTool model (services/machine_tool/umati) - the
Browse hierarchy + the Read resolver over a bound UmatiMachineTool are host-tested here.
Requires the OPC UA codec. No heap, no stdlib.

native_robotics.desc:
OPC UA for Robotics (OPC 40010-1) MotionDeviceSystem model (services/machine_tool/robotics) - the Browse
hierarchy + the Read resolver over a bound RoboticsMotionDeviceSystem, including the parametric
Axes, are host-tested here. Requires the OPC UA codec. No heap, no stdlib.

native_euromap77.desc:
EUROMAP 77 (OPC 40077) IMM_MES_Interface model (services/machine_tool/euromap77) - OPC UA for injection
molding machines. The Browse hierarchy + the Read resolver over a bound EmImm, including the
UInt64 production counters, are host-tested here. Requires the OPC UA codec. No heap, no stdlib.

native_pentest.desc:
Adversarial / pentest harness - run SEPARATELY (`pio test -e native_pentest`),
NOT part of run_tests.sh. Fuzzes the untrusted-input parsers (HTTP, multipart,
CoAP, SNMP+BER, Modbus, CBOR, MessagePack, JSON, base64/base32, the SQLite
on-disk file-format reader, the Redis RESP reply decoder, the OPC UA Binary
message parsers, the SMB2 client response parsers + the SPNEGO DER walker +
NTLMSSP CHALLENGE, the DNC block decoder, the FTP client reply parsers, and the
industrial client response parsers FINS / MELSEC / CIP / EtherNet-IP / DF1, the
BACnet/IP + ISO-transport TPKT/COTP frame parsers, the IEEE C37.118
synchrophasor + FINS command parsers, the JWT HS256 token verifier, the
DirectNET / CC-Link / AMQP / MMS frame parsers, the DDS/RTPS UDP submessage
walker, the WebDAV (RFC 4918) PROPPATCH body walker + Destination-header
percent-decoder, and the HPACK HTTP/2 + QPACK HTTP/3 header-block decoders) with malformed/oversized/partial/random/mutated input and asserts bounded
buffers + fail-closed + termination (no crash, no over-read, no hang). Pairs with
the live driver penetration_testing/pc_pentest.py. See docs/PENTEST.md.

native_keepalive.desc:
HTTP/1.1 keep-alive (persistent connections): full server built with
PC_ENABLE_KEEPALIVE=1; a small per-connection request cap makes the
fairness-bound test fast. Drives requests through the real transport ring +
tcp_write capture mock.

native_range.desc:
HTTP Range requests / 206 Partial Content (RFC 7233): full server built with
PC_ENABLE_RANGE=1, exercising serve_file() against the mock FS (now with
seek()) via the tcp_write capture mock.

native_syslog.desc:
Syslog client (RFC 5424) line formatter. Pure formatter - no lwIP/UDP - so it
unit-tests on the host (udp_transport provides host stubs for pc_udp_sendto).

native_smb.desc:
SMB2 client (network_drivers/application/smb, MS-SMB2 / MS-NLMP): the SMB2 wire codec (transport frame,
sync header, NEGOTIATE, SESSION_SETUP, TREE_CONNECT/CREATE/CLOSE/READ/WRITE); the NTLM digests
MD4 (RFC 1320) / MD5 (RFC 1321) / HMAC-MD5 (RFC 2104) KAT-verified vs the RFC vectors; the
NTLMv2 response (NThash / NTOWFv2 / NTProofStr / SessionBaseKey) vs the MS-NLMP section 4.2
worked example; the NTLMSSP message codec; the SPNEGO GSS-API DER wrapping (RFC 4178) verified
byte-exact + independently vs openssl; and the smb_client dialogue engine (the full NEGOTIATE
-> NTLMv2 SESSION_SETUP -> TREE_CONNECT -> CREATE -> CLOSE handshake) driven by a scripted mock
SMB2 server over a send/recv seam. Pure host tests.

native_smtp.desc:
SMTP client (RFC 5321) dialogue engine (services/net/smtp/smtp_run): greeting/EHLO/AUTH
LOGIN/MAIL/RCPT/DATA over a send/recv seam, with dot-stuffing + multi-line reply
parsing. Driven by a scripted mock server on the host - no lwIP or TLS.

native_ntp_server.desc:
NTP/SNTP server (RFC 5905 server mode) response codec (ntp_server_build_response):
version echo, mode/LI/stratum, origin-timestamp copy, reference/receive/transmit
stamps, big-endian encoding, and the length guards. Pure - host-tested, no lwIP.

native_dns_server.desc:
Authoritative DNS server (services/net/dns_server): the pure A-record response builder
(QNAME parse, compressed A answer, NXDOMAIN, non-A query, header flags, malformed
guards) and the built-in name->IP table (add / case-insensitive lookup / clear). No lwIP.

native_rtc.desc:
DS1307/DS3231 RTC conversions (services/peripherals/rtc): BCD time registers <-> Unix epoch in
24- and 12-hour encodings, leap years, clock-halt/century bit masks, range validation,
and a round-trip over the 2000-2099 range. Pure - the I2C read/write is ESP32-only.

native_relay.desc:
TCP relay / DNAT byte pump (services/net/relay): the bidirectional relay engine that
publishes an internal host:port through the server. Tests cover a bidirectional transfer, the
backpressure carry (a send that accepts partial writes), independent half-close with shutdown
propagation, a large multi-step transfer (byte-exact), and a seam error - driven by two mock
sockets over the send/recv seams. Pure host tests.

native_ld2410.desc:
LD2410 mmWave radar codec (services/peripherals/ld2410): decoding a basic and an engineering-mode
report frame, rejecting malformed frames, the byte-by-byte stream reassembler (resync past
noise, split feeds, absurd-length drop), the presence/distance helpers, and the exact bytes
of the config-command encoders. Pure - the UART pump is ESP32-only.

native_safety_scl.desc:
IEC 61784-3 black-channel Safety Communication Layer primitives (services/machine_tool/safety_scl):
the monitoring-counter state machine, the receive watchdog, and the fail-safe latch the four safety
profiles compose. Covers each way a black channel misbehaves - corruption, loss, duplication,
reordering, insertion - plus the watchdog (incl. a millis() rollover and the disabled case), the
no-silent-reheal latch, counter wrapping at a narrow modulus, and the explicit re-establish. The
CRC is the profile's, not this module's. Pure core on a synthetic clock. Pure host tests.

native_hmmd.desc:
Waveshare HMMD 24GHz mmWave micro-motion radar codec (services/peripherals/hmmd): the LD2410-family
little-endian framing, the report parse (detection flag, distance, all 16 gate energies), rejecting
malformed frames, the byte-by-byte stream reassembler (resync past noise, split feeds, absurd-length
drop), the exact bytes of the command encoders (open/close command mode, firmware 0x0000, serial
0x0011, config 0x0008, register 0x0002), and ACK decoding. Pure - the UART pump is ESP32-only.

native_rcwl0516.desc:
RCWL-0516 Doppler presence sensor + the shared one-GPIO presence facade
(services/peripherals/rcwl0516): the debounce that swallows comparator chatter, the hold that bridges the
module's ~2s retrigger gaps into one continuous presence span, the consume-once edge event,
wrap-safety across a millis() rollover, and the degenerate zero-debounce / zero-hold configs.
Pure core driven by a synthetic clock - no GPIO, no real time. Pure host tests.

native_sen0192.desc:
SEN0192 microwave motion sensor presence state machine (services/peripherals/sen0192): presence
asserts on an active sample and holds for the configured window after the last active sample, clears
after it, counts clear->present edges, and honors OUT polarity. Pure - the GPIO read is ESP32-only.

native_mpr121.desc:
MPR121 capacitive-touch codec (services/peripherals/mpr121): decoding the touch-status word into
an electrode bitmask (masking proximity / over-current), the per-electrode touched test, the
proximity / over-current flags, the 10-bit filtered/baseline word, and the exact bytes of the
register bring-up sequence. Pure - the I2C read/write is ESP32-only.

native_sht3x.desc:
Sensirion SHT3x temperature/humidity codec (services/peripherals/sht3x): the CRC-8 against the
datasheet check value (0xBEEF -> 0x92), the raw-tick -> milli-unit temperature/humidity
conversions at the range endpoints and a mid value, and the six-byte single-shot response
parse (both CRCs checked, corrupt CRC rejected). Pure - the I2C transfer is ESP32-only.

native_pca9685.desc:
PCA9685 PWM/servo codec (services/peripherals/pca9685): the PRESCALE computation from a PWM
frequency (with clamping), the per-channel register address, the servo pulse-width -> 12-bit
count conversion (with clamping), and the 5-byte channel PWM write encoder (including the
full-on/off flag). Pure - the I2C writes are ESP32-only.

native_ads1115.desc:
ADS1115 16-bit ADC codec (services/peripherals/ads1115): building the 16-bit config word for a
single-shot single-ended reading (channel MUX, gain, data rate, start/mode/comparator bits,
with out-of-range fallbacks), and converting a signed 16-bit sample to microvolts across the
gain's full-scale range. Pure - the I2C transfer is ESP32-only.

native_ina219.desc:
INA219 current/power codec (services/peripherals/ina219): decoding the bus-voltage register (bits
[15:3], LSB 4 mV, status bits ignored) and the shunt-voltage register (signed, LSB 10 uV),
computing the calibration register from the current LSB and shunt resistance, and scaling the
raw current / power registers. Pure - the I2C transfer is ESP32-only.

native_hpack.desc:
HPACK header compression for HTTP/2 (RFC 7541): prefix-integer coding (App C.1), the
Huffman string code (App B / C.4.1), the first-request decode with dynamic-table insertion
(C.3.1), dynamic-table indexing + FIFO eviction + size updates, and the server encoder
(static indexing + literal round-trip). Pure host codec.

native_h2frame.desc:
HTTP/2 binary framing (network_drivers/presentation/http/http2/h2_frame, RFC 9113): the
9-byte frame header parse/write (24-bit length, reserved-bit masking), SETTINGS build + parse
with validation, and the exact bytes of the SETTINGS-ACK / WINDOW_UPDATE / RST_STREAM / GOAWAY
/ PING-ACK / HEADERS / DATA builders. Pure host codec.

native_h2conn.desc:
HTTP/2 connection engine (network_drivers/presentation/http/http2/h2_conn, RFC 9113):
initial SETTINGS on init, preface + client SETTINGS -> SETTINGS ACK, decoding a real
HPACK-encoded request into the header callbacks, PING -> PING ACK, split-across-reads frame
reassembly, and h2_conn_respond serializing a HEADERS + DATA response decoded back.

native_quic_varint.desc:
QUIC variable-length integer codec (network_drivers/presentation/http/http3/quic_varint,
RFC 9000 sec 16) - the foundational HTTP/3 primitive: the Appendix A.1 worked examples (1/2/4/8
byte encodings), the non-minimal decode, length computation, and overflow / truncation guards.

native_h3frame.desc:
HTTP/3 framing (network_drivers/presentation/http/http3/h3_frame, RFC 9114 sec 7): the
type+length varint header parse/write (incl. a multi-byte length), the DATA / HEADERS /
SETTINGS / GOAWAY builders, the SETTINGS payload round-trip + reserved-id rejection, and the
reserved HTTP/2 frame-type check. Pure host codec.

native_jwt.desc:
JWT (HS256) bearer-auth verification. Pure crypto/codec - reuses the SSH
HMAC-SHA-256 + base64 primitives - so it unit-tests on the host.

native_upload.desc:
Streaming file upload: POST body -> FS file via the parser streaming hook.
Small BODY_BUF_SIZE exercises multi-chunk streaming; the mock FS captures the
written bytes (test/mocks/FS.h write-capture).

native_http_client.desc:
Outbound HTTP client: URL parser + request builder + response parser. Pure
string logic (the lwIP/mbedTLS transport is ESP32-only) so it unit-tests host.

native_compliance.desc:
RFC-compliance suite: builds with all enforcement at production defaults
(PC_ENFORCE_HOST_HEADER=1) and exercises the strict behaviors.

native_plaintext.desc:
The plaintext pool accessor (server/mmgr/plaintext): bump-allocate + reset semantics,
alignment, and fail-closed exhaustion. Pure host tests - no lwIP/sockets - so it builds from
the accessor and the pool mechanism alone.

native_inflate.desc:
RFC 1951 INFLATE core (the WebSocket permessage-deflate decompressor). Pure
codec - no sockets - so it unit-tests on the host against zlib-generated
vectors (scratchpad/gen_vectors.py).

native_deflate.desc:
RFC 1951 DEFLATE core (the WebSocket permessage-deflate compressor). Pure codec
- no sockets - so it unit-tests on the host by round-tripping through INFLATE
(which test_inflate validates against zlib), proving the emitted streams are
valid RFC 1951.

native_ssh_zlib.desc:
SSH server-to-client streaming compressor (zlib@openssh.com / zlib): a context-takeover
DEFLATE stream (persistent sliding window across packets, sync-flush per packet, zlib
wrapper). The whole session is one zlib stream, so concatenating packets and decoding via
inflate_raw (validated vs Python zlib in test_inflate) proves cross-packet back-references
resolve; packet-by-packet decodability under a reference zlib.decompressobj (OpenSSH's model)
is cross-checked out-of-tree.

native_ssh_comp.desc:
SSH s2c compression WIRING with the full SSH stack built with PC_ENABLE_SSH_ZLIB=1:
the compression owner (ssh_comp) + its NEWKEYS / USERAUTH_SUCCESS activation + the packet-layer
compress path in ssh_pkt_send. Drives the packet layer directly and reconstructs the continuous
zlib stream from the framed packets, decoding via inflate_raw. Compile-verifies every #if
PC_ENABLE_SSH_ZLIB block across transport / server / packet.

native_ws_deflate.desc:
WebSocket permessage-deflate (RFC 7692) inbound path wired through the real WS
stack: handshake negotiation, the RSV1 frame path, and INFLATE delivery (with
the table scratch borrowed from the shared arena). Runs test_websocket with the
feature on (the deflate cases are #if-gated).

native_time_source.desc:
Multi-source time fallback matrix (services/timing_position/time_source): priority-ordered
query of user time sources with first-valid-wins fallback. Pure core - no
sockets/RTC - so it unit-tests on the host with mock sources.

native_config_store.desc:
Typed NVS config store (services/storage/config_store): string/u32/blob round-trips,
defaults, capacity, erase/clear - run against the host in-memory backend (the
ESP32 Preferences/NVS backend is compiled in only on-target).

native_device_id.desc:
MAC-derived device UUID (server/signaling/device_id): RFC 4122 v5 from a MAC via SHA-1.
Pure core - the ESP32 MAC read is ARDUINO-gated - so it unit-tests on the host
against Python uuid.uuid5 reference values.

native_auth_lockout.desc:
Per-IP brute-force auth lockout (services/security/auth_lockout): exponential-backoff
lockout state machine. Pure core (the millisecond clock is passed in), so it
unit-tests on the host. PC_ENABLE_AUTH_LOCKOUT (and its required parent
PC_ENABLE_AUTH) are set so the flag-guarded code compiles.

native_forwarded_trust.desc:
Trusted-reverse-proxy forwarded-client resolver (services/security/forwarded_trust): a
Forwarded / X-Forwarded-For client address is honored only when the real TCP peer
is a configured trusted-upstream CIDR, else the TCP peer is kept. Pure (no
sockets), so it host-tests; a direct/untrusted peer's spoofed header is never
believed. PC_ENABLE_FORWARDED_TRUST (+ its required parents AUTH / AUTH_LOCKOUT)
are set so the flag-guarded config compiles.

native_csrf.desc:
Stateless HMAC-signed CSRF token (services/security/csrf): issue/verify with a fixed
secret unit-tests on the host (PC_ENABLE_CSRF set). Pulls in the SSH
HMAC-SHA256 + SHA-256 core.

native_telemetry.desc:
Telemetry math (services/iot/telemetry): moving-window stats, rate-of-change, and
totalizer. Pure computation (synthetic clock passed in), so it unit-tests on
the host.

native_net_egress.desc:
Egress-interface reporting (network_drivers/physical). The esp_netif default-
route lookups are ESP32-only; the pure interface-key classifier host-tests here.

native_client.desc:
Outbound TCP client transport (network_drivers/transport/client.cpp), the pooled
layer-4 peer of tcp.cpp used by http_client / mqtt / ws_client / relay / smtp / ssh
port-forward (PC_NEED_DET_CLIENT). The tcpip_api_call-marshaled lwIP path is
ARDUINO-only; on native this file compiles to just the !NEED stub (fail-closed: no
lwIP on the host, so every call reports no connection), host-tested here for its own sake
since no other env's build_src_filter pulls this file in at all.

native_partition.desc:
Flash partition-map monitor (services/storage/partition_monitor core): the kind
classifier + JSON serializer host-test here; the esp_partition walk is ESP32-only.

native_cbor.desc:
CBOR (RFC 8949) encoder (network_drivers/presentation/codec/cbor): a pure byte-output
codec, host-tested against the RFC 8949 Appendix A vectors.

native_msgpack.desc:
MessagePack encoder (network_drivers/presentation/codec/msgpack): a pure byte-output
codec, host-tested against the spec encodings.

native_gpio_map.desc:
GPIO pin-mapper / browser diag core (server/signaling/gpio_map): direction names, JSON
serializer, control-POST parser, output guard - all pure and host-tested.

native_udp_telemetry.desc:
UDP telemetry line builder (services/iot/udp_telemetry): InfluxDB line-protocol
formatting, host-tested. The UDP cast is ESP32-only (#ifdef ARDUINO).

native_statsd.desc:
StatsD metrics client (services/iot/statsd): the pure line formatter (name:value|type,
sample rate, DogStatsD tags) plus the count/gauge/timing/set emit helpers, whose sent
bytes are captured through the transport UDP service's host seam.

native_guardrails.desc:
Heap/stack guardrails (services/security/guardrails): threshold evaluator + JSON,
host-tested. Live sampling is ESP32-only (#ifdef ARDUINO).

native_failsafe.desc:
Software watchdog / deadlock detection + safe-state (server/failsafe): the wrap-safe
overdue predicate, the lifeline registry, fire-once-per-episode breach callback, and JSON.
Pure host tests with a synthetic clock.

native_sleep_sched.desc:
Dynamic sleep-cycle scheduler (server/sleep_sched): the wrap-safe idle->sleep-window
decision core with a doubling ramp clamped to a ceiling. Pure host tests, synthetic clock.

native_signaling.desc:
Application-layer signaling (server/signaling): the state bucket. Deposits go in from the loop
(response class tallies, and the uptime + conn/listener bitmasks a tick already has in hand), a
read hands back a copy rather than a window, and kill forwards a slot to the transport unchanged.
The module holds no logic by design, so the tests assert exactly that. pc_conn_close is stubbed:
the forward is what is under test, not lwIP.

native_wearlevel.desc:
Flash wear-leveling slot selector (server/filesystem/wearlevel): least-worn pick (ties -> lowest
index), saturating mark, and the wear-imbalance spread metric. Pure host tests - a 4000-write
pick+mark loop must level every slot exactly.

native_netadapt.desc:
Network adaptation decisions (services/net/netadapt): TCP receive-window sizing from the free
heap (reserve + quarter-of-spare, clamped) and the DHCP->static-IP fallback trigger. Pure host tests.

native_dshot.desc:
DShot ESC throttle codec (services/peripherals/dshot): the 16-bit frame (11-bit value + telemetry +
4-bit nibble-xor CRC), the bidirectional inverted-CRC variant, decode/validate, and per-rate bit
timing. Pure host tests with hand-computed vectors.

native_hart.desc:
HART / HART-IP codec (services/fieldbus/hart): the HART command frame (longitudinal XOR checksum,
short + long addressing) build/parse and the 8-octet HART-IP message header. Pure host tests with
hand-verified vectors (command-0 checksum 0x82).

native_nts.desc:
Network Time Security codec (network_drivers/application/nts, RFC 8915): the NTS-KE TLV records (build the
standard request, parse a response) and the NTS NTP extension-field framing (unique id / cookie,
RFC 7822 4-byte padding). Pure host tests with spec-derived vectors.

native_dds.desc:
DDS / RTPS framing codec (services/iot/dds): the 20-octet RTPS header (magic/version/vendor/
guidPrefix) and the submessage TLV (id/flags/octetsToNextHeader, endianness flag), build + parse.
Pure host tests with spec-derived vectors.

native_xmpp.desc:
XMPP stanza codec (services/iot/xmpp, RFC 6120): XML-escaped stream/message/presence/iq
builders and the stanza-name + attribute readers. Pure host tests with exact-output vectors.

native_rawl2.desc:
Raw L2 Ethernet frame codec (services/fieldbus/rawl2): Ethernet II + 802.1Q VLAN build/parse and the
802.3 FCS (CRC-32). Pure host tests (FCS check value 0xCBF43926).

native_spa_router.desc:
Single-page-app micro-routing (services/web/spa_router): the serve-file / serve-shell /
passthrough decision from a request path (extension test + API prefix). Pure host tests.

native_goose.desc:
IEC 61850 GOOSE publisher codec (services/energy/goose): the BER IECGoosePdu (gocbRef..allData,
minimal-length INTEGERs with the positive leading-zero rule) + the GOOSE header + Ethernet frame
(ethertype 0x88B8). Pure host tests with structural + spec-derived vectors.

native_mtconnect.desc:
MTConnect agent response codec (services/machine_tool/mtconnect, ANSI/MTC1.4): the incremental
MTConnectStreams builder (header + Samples/Events/Condition), the MTConnectDevices probe (device
model), the MTConnectAssets response (CuttingTool life cycle), the sample sequence cursor (a rolling
observation ring replayed as a from/count long-poll window), and the MTConnectError document,
XML-escaped. Pure host tests with structural assertions.

native_wal.desc:
Write-ahead store for atomic buffer-to-flash storage (services/storage/wal): CRC32 record
framing + crash-recovery replay (the atomicity core), plus the A/B superblock + checkpoint + mount
layer over a block-device seam. Pure host tests, incl. the CRC-32 check vector, torn/truncated-tail
recovery to the last good record, checkpoint durability, and superblock fallback.

native_j2735.desc:
SAE J2735 V2X codec (services/transportation/j2735): the ASN.1 UPER bit primitive layer (constrained
INTEGER / BOOLEAN / bit fields) and the BSMcore block encode/decode. Pure host tests with
hand-computed bit patterns (162-bit BSMcore -> 21 octets).

native_nema_ts2.desc:
NEMA TS 2 SDLC frame codec (services/transportation/nema_ts2): the traffic-cabinet bus frame
([address][control][frame-type][data][CRC-16/X-25]) build + validate. Pure host tests (CRC check
value 0x906E).

native_snp.desc:
GE Fanuc SNP serial frame codec (services/fieldbus/snp): the Series Ninety Protocol frame
([control][length][data][arithmetic-sum BCC]) build + validate. Pure host tests.

native_directnet.desc:
AutomationDirect DirectNET serial frame codec (services/fieldbus/directnet): the header (SOH +
ASCII-hex slave/type/addr/blocks + ETB + LRC) and data (STX + data + ETX + LRC) frames build/parse.
Pure host tests.

native_sep2.desc:
IEEE 2030.5 (SEP 2.0) resource codec (services/energy/sep2): the DeviceCapability, EndDevice,
and DERControl XML documents (urn:ieee:std:2030.5:ns), XML-escaped. Pure host tests.

native_profinet.desc:
PROFINET DCP frame codec (services/fieldbus/profinet): the 10-octet DCP header + option/suboption
blocks (even-padding) build + parse/walk, for Identify/Set over raw L2 (ethertype 0x8892). Pure host
tests with spec-derived vectors.

native_ntcip.desc:
NTCIP transportation object OIDs (services/transportation/ntcip): the NTCIP 1202 signal-controller +
1203 DMS object roots under 1.3.6.1.4.1.1206.4.2 and the OID builder (root + instance index), for the
shipped SNMP agent. Pure host tests.

native_openadr.desc:
OpenADR 3.0 JSON codec (services/energy/openadr): the event (programID + eventName + interval
payloads) and report (VEN reading) JSON documents build, with escaping + a no-stdlib 3-decimal
formatter. Pure host tests.

native_mms.desc:
IEC 61850 MMS PDU codec (services/energy/mms): the BER confirmed-request/response Read PDUs
(invokeID + read service + named ObjectName), build + parse. Pure host tests with structural vectors.

native_cclink.desc:
CC-Link cyclic fieldbus frame codec (services/fieldbus/cclink): the frame ([station][command][bit
data][word data][sum]) build + parse and the bit/word process-image accessors. Pure host tests.

native_powerlink.desc:
Ethernet POWERLINK basic frame codec (services/fieldbus/powerlink): the EPL cyclic frames
([messageType][dest][source][payload]) - SoC/PReq/PRes/SoA - build + parse, over raw L2 (0x88AB).
Pure host tests.

native_sercos.desc:
SERCOS III motion-bus codec (services/fieldbus/sercos): the MDT/AT telegram (type + phase + cycle
+ data) build + parse and the 16-bit IDN encode/decode (S/P + set + block). Pure host tests.

native_profibus.desc:
PROFIBUS-DP FDL telegram codec (services/fieldbus/profibus): the SD1 (no-data) + SD2 (variable
data, LE/LEr + arithmetic-sum FCS) telegrams build + validate. Pure host tests with spec-derived
vectors.

native_lonworks.desc:
LonWorks / LON-IP network-variable codec (services/fieldbus/lonworks): the LonTalk NV PDU
([msg-code][14-bit selector][value]) build + parse and the SNVT_temp / SNVT_switch scalar encodings.
Pure host tests.

native_mbplus.desc:
Modbus Plus HDLC token-bus codec (services/fieldbus/mbplus): the HDLC frame (7E addr ctrl payload
CRC-16/X-25 7E) build + validate and the token-rotation ring helper. Pure host tests (CRC 0x906E).

native_interbus.desc:
INTERBUS summation-frame codec (services/fieldbus/interbus): the summation frame (loopback +
per-device 16-bit slices + CRC-16/CCITT FCS) assemble + disassemble. Pure host tests (FCS 0x29B1).

native_iccp.desc:
ICCP / TASE.2 (IEC 60870-6) Data_Value codec (services/energy/iccp): the StateQ (state + quality)
and RealQ (scaled INTEGER + quality) indication-point BER structures with optional timestamp. Pure
host tests with spec-derived vectors.

native_wave.desc:
IEEE 1609 WAVE codec (services/transportation/wave): the 1609.3 WSMP header (version + P-encoded PSID +
length) build + parse, the PSID p-encoding, and the 1609.2 secured-message envelope header. Pure host
tests (carries J2735).

native_utmc.desc:
UTMC common-database codec (services/transportation/utmc): the UTMCRequest (object id) and UTMCResponse
(value + quality + timestamp) HTTP/XML documents build + the request-id parse, escaped. Pure host tests.

native_ocit.desc:
OCIT-Outstations message codec (services/transportation/ocit): the object message
([msg-type][object-type][instance][data-type][value]) build + parse and the typed-value accessors.
Pure host tests.

native_atc.desc:
ATC field-I/O interop snapshot (services/machine_tool/atc): serialize this device's field-I/O map
as {"inputs":[...],"outputs":[...]} JSON for an ATC engine over HTTP, plus the output setter and
value getter. Pure host tests.

native_southbound.desc:
Southbound protocol-driver framework (services/net/southbound): the bounded driver registry
(register / find / clear / count) and the name-dispatched read/write/read_block/write_block facade,
including capability + not-found handling and transport-error passthrough. Pure host tests.

native_sb_modbus.desc:
Modbus-master southbound driver adapter (services/net/southbound/sb_modbus): binds the
transport-agnostic Modbus TCP master codec into the southbound driver framework, so an app
reads/writes register points by driver name through the one facade. Host-tested end to end
against the real slave codec (pc_modbus_process_adu) over a mock transaction seam.

native_exc_decoder.desc:
ESP32 panic / exception decoder (server/exc_decoder): parse a captured Guru Meditation
dump (cause, register PC + EXCVADDR, backtrace PC:SP frames) into a structured ExcInfo and serialize it
as JSON for a live /exception panel; tolerates missing fields + a trailing corruption marker. Pure host tests.

native_http_delivery.desc:
HTTP delivery optimizations (services/file_transfer/http_delivery): the RFC 5861 stale-while-revalidate
freshness decision + its Cache-Control builder, and the versioned service-worker precache manifest
(including that a full PC_DELIVERY_PRECACHE_MAX manifest fits PC_DELIVERY_MANIFEST_BUF and that an
oversized one fails closed rather than truncating). Byte-range serving is network_drivers/application/http_range.h's job,
not this service's. Pure host tests.

native_hw_health.desc:
Hardware-health diagnostics (server/signaling/hw_health): power-rail voltage-drop logger (worst
droop + sag/brownout counts), SPI-bus CRC audit with hysteretic clock backoff, GPIO short-circuit test
(driven vs readback), and capacitor-leakage diag (measured vs expected RC decay). Pure host tests.

native_mdns_adaptive.desc:
Adaptive mDNS beacon scheduling (network_drivers/application/mdns_adaptive): RF-contention backoff/recovery
of the announce interval, the TTL/2 continuous-refresher cadence, the announce-due check, and the
auto-sleep beacon (announce before a sleep that would lapse the record). Wrap-safe. Pure host tests.

native_sockpool.desc:
Dynamic socket recycling (services/net/sockpool): a fixed LRU connection-slot pool - acquire
(free slot, else recycle the least-recently-used and report the evicted id), touch, release, find, and
in-use count. Pure host tests.

native_psram_pool.desc:
Buffer placement policy + DMA ping-pong (services/storage/psram_pool): pc_psram_place picks
DRAM vs PSRAM by size / DMA requirement / free-heap headroom (large-cold to PSRAM, small-hot + DMA to
DRAM, leaving a DRAM reserve), plus the SPI DMA ping-pong double-buffer index bookkeeping. Pure host tests.

native_happy_eyeballs.desc:
Dual-stack Happy Eyeballs selection (services/net/happy_eyeballs): RFC 6724 destination
preference scoring, the candidate-list sort + RFC 8305 address-family interleave, and the Connection
Attempt Delay gate, over the shipped pc_ip. Pure host tests.

native_wifi_sniffer.desc:
802.11 sniffer / traffic analyzer (services/radio/wifi_sniffer): decode an 802.11 MAC header
(frame-control type/subtype + flags, ToDS/FromDS-dependent addresses), tally frames by type, the
RSSI-hysteresis channel-agility roaming decision, the channel-hop dwell schedule (hop/wrap/sweep
counting, clamping, millis-rollover safety), and the per-channel RSSI survey (best RSSI + BSSID per
channel, out-of-range rejection, strongest-other-channel candidate feeding the roam decision).
Pure host tests.

native_link_manager.desc:
Multi-interface egress selection (server/signaling/link_manager): a table of interfaces (kind +
priority + up/down) with deterministic best-link-up selection, graceful escalation to a higher-priority
interface, failover when it drops, and real-transition change detection. Pure host tests.

native_cc1101.desc:
CC1101 sub-GHz radio driver (services/radio/cc1101): the TI SPI header protocol (config
registers, command strobes, status registers, TX/RX FIFO) - init/detect, variable-length send, TX-done,
set-rx, packet recv with appended RSSI/LQI, and RSSI-to-dBm decode, against a mock chip. Host tests.

native_fdc2214.desc:
FDC2114/2214 capacitance-to-digital field sensor (services/peripherals/fdc2214): the 28-bit data
combine + error flags, the frequency scale (data/2^28 * fref), and the single-channel config-sequence
builder. Pure codec host tests (the I2C binding is ESP32-only).

native_ldc1614.desc:
LDC1614 inductance-to-digital field sensor (services/peripherals/ldc1614): the 28-bit data combine +
error flags, the frequency scale (data/2^28 * fref), and the single-channel config-sequence builder.
Pure codec host tests (the I2C binding is ESP32-only).

native_vl53l0x.desc:
VL53L0X time-of-flight ranging codec (services/peripherals/vl53l0x): the range byte-pair combine to
millimeters, the interrupt-status data-ready decode, and the device range-status validity check. Pure
codec host tests (the I2C ranging binding is ESP32-only).

native_radio_sniff.desc:
Receive-only radio channel sniffer -> pcap (services/radio/radio_sniff): the int->float32 RSSI
encode, the pcap global header (DLT 802.15.4 TAP), and the per-frame TAP record (RSSI + channel TLVs +
MAC frame) so a sniffed radio channel opens in Wireshark. Pure host tests.

native_ble_gatt.desc:
Bluetooth ATT codec + GATT bridge (services/radio/ble_gatt): build/parse the common ATT PDUs
(read/write/notify/error, LE handles) and serialize a GATT characteristic table as JSON for the web
stack. Pure host tests.

native_tls_policy.desc:
TLS version negotiation + pinned cipher policy (services/security/tls_policy): the server-style
version pick (highest supported not above the client's), the version name, cipher selection by server
preference from the offered set, and the AEAD-suite classifier. Pure host tests.

native_wisun.desc:
Wi-SUN FAN border-router connector (services/radio/wisun): the CoAP client request builder (RFC
7252 header + Uri-Path options with extended-length + payload) and the FAN node registry (register / find
/ joined-count / JSON) over pc_ip. Pure host tests.

native_logbuf.desc: Rotating log ring + severity trap (server/logbuf): pure, fully host-tested.

native_power_mgmt.desc:
SoC power governor (server/power_mgmt): the pure clock decision from load, die
temperature and reset reason - load-based scaling, the thermal hysteresis that stops a part parked at
the limit from oscillating (asserted by feeding the plan's own output back for 20 ticks and counting
one transition), post-brownout recovery holding the floor even when busy and cool, the precedence
between the three, and INT16_MIN meaning no sensor rather than ice-cold.

native_hotswap.desc:
Removable-storage hot-swap safeties (services/storage/hotswap): the ABSENT/READY/FAULTED state
machine - a run of consecutive I/O errors faults a volume while a single one does not, any success
resets the run, the fail counter saturates instead of wrapping, probe attempts are rate-limited (and
wrap-safe across a millis() rollover), present-but-unmountable stays absent, and a full
removal/reinsertion cycle returns to a clean mount. Pure host tests with a synthetic clock.

native_log.desc:
Abstract logging macros (shared_primitives/log.h) whose disabled levels are discarded by
the preprocessor: built at PC_LOG_LEVEL_INFO so DEBUG is below the floor. Asserts that a discarded
call reaches neither the sink nor the ring and never even evaluates its arguments, that INFO/WARN/ERROR
emit with the right level, that the PC_LOG_LEVEL_* values agree with pc_log_level's, and the formatting
edges (truncation, null format, empty message).

native_config_io.desc:
Schema-driven config export/restore (services/storage/config_io) over the config store;
round-trip host-tested against the in-memory backend.

native_workers.desc:
Core-partitioning invariant at N=2 (PC_WORKER_COUNT=2): each worker reaps
only its owned slots (check_timeouts ownership). Per-worker queue routing is
hardware-verified (the host queue mock ignores the handle).

native_codeql.desc:
CodeQL coverage env: the full app compiled with every new feature flag ON so
CodeQL traces the integration paths (CSRF / lockout / allowlist gates,
permessage-deflate) AND the new service modules, which the per-feature envs scan
only in isolation. Built (--without-testing) by the CodeQL workflow; one test
in the filter is enough to pull in the whole src set.

native_clock.desc:
Pluggable monotonic clock (server/clock): default millis(), custom clock
divided down to the internal 1000 Hz, plus the microsecond base and latency
budgeting. Builds server/clock/clock.c, which owns the installed-clock state.

native_concurrency.desc:
Concurrency proof for the cross-thread slot fields (pc_atomic state / rx_head /
rx_tail). Two threads drive one slot's SPSC ring with the production access
pattern; asserts byte-exact in-order delivery. Portable (-pthread), runs on any
host including Windows - this verifies the data integrity / logic.

native_tsan.desc:
Same harness under ThreadSanitizer: proves ZERO data races on the slot fields
(the pc_atomic acquire/release happens-before lets the plain rx_buffer[] writes
be read on the other core safely). TSan ships with clang/gcc on Linux, so this
env is run by the test CI (ubuntu); it is not buildable on the Windows host.

native_qpack.desc:
QPACK field-section compression for HTTP/3 (network_drivers/presentation/http/http3/qpack,
RFC 9204): the Appendix B.1 worked example (literal field line with a static name reference), the
encoder's exact bytes for an indexed / name-reference / literal-name field line, a round-trip
through all three representations, and rejection of any dynamic-table reference. Pure host codec.

native_quic_packet.desc:
QUIC packet header + packet-number codec (network_drivers/presentation/http/http3/quic_packet,
RFC 9000 sec 17): the long-header build/parse round-trip, a Version Negotiation packet (Version 0
+ supported-version list), the short (1-RTT) header parse, and packet-number truncation coding
against the Appendix A.2 (encode) and A.3 (decode) worked examples. Pure host codec.

native_quic_frame.desc:
QUIC frame codec (network_drivers/presentation/http/http3/quic_frame, RFC 9000 sec 19):
builder/parser round-trips for PADDING/PING/HANDSHAKE_DONE, ACK (single-range + a hand-built
multi-range-with-ECN cursor advance), CRYPTO, STREAM (with/without Offset, LEN-absent to packet
end), MAX_DATA, CONNECTION_CLOSE (transport + app), a multi-frame sequential parse, truncation.

native_quic_crypto.desc:
QUIC Initial packet crypto (crypto/hkdf + quic_aead +
quic_crypto, RFC 9001): HKDF-Expand-Label key derivation, AEAD_AES_128_GCM (software AES-128 +
GHASH) and header protection. Checked against FIPS 197 (AES block), GCM Test Case 4, and RFC 9001
Appendix A - A.1 secrets, A.3 server Initial byte-exact, A.2 client Initial + sample, A.4 Retry tag.

native_dtls.desc:
DTLS 1.3 record layer (network_drivers/presentation/security/dtls/dtls_record, RFC 9147 sec 4):
DTLSPlaintext + DTLSCiphertext protect/unprotect, the unified header, sequence-number encryption
(sec 4.2.3) and reconstruction (sec 4.2.2), the AEAD nonce, and the anti-replay window (sec 4.5.1).
The key + record KAT is byte-exact against an independent HKDF-Expand-Label + AEAD_AES_128_GCM +
AES-ECB reconstruction (RFC 5869 / RFC 8446 / SP 800-38D). Pure host tests.

native_dtls_hs.desc:
DTLS 1.3 handshake framing + reliability (network_drivers/presentation/security/dtls/dtls_handshake,
RFC 9147 sec 5 + 7): the 12-byte DTLS handshake header, overlap-tolerant message reassembly, the
ACK message (content type 26), and the stateless HelloRetryRequest cookie (sec 5.1). The cookie
wire format is byte-exact against an independent Python-stdlib HMAC-SHA256, proving the field
layout and the client-address binding. Pure host tests.

native_dtls_tls13.desc:
TLS 1.3 messages the DTLS 1.3 handshake adds to tls13_msg (RFC 8446 sec 4.1.4 / 4.4.1),
compiled for the DTLS path (PC_ENABLE_DTLS, not HTTP/3): the HelloRetryRequest builder, the
cookie extension parse, the empty EncryptedExtensions, and the message_hash transcript wrapper.
The HelloRetryRequest is byte-exact, anchored on the RFC 8446 sec 4.1.3 magic random. Also the RFC
7250 Raw Public Keys codec (PC_ENABLE_TLS_RPK): the Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo encoder, the
RawPublicKey Certificate message, the server_certificate_type EncryptedExtensions, and the
server_certificate_type ClientHello parse. Pure host tests.

native_dtls_conn.desc:
DTLS 1.3 server handshake state machine (network_drivers/presentation/security/dtls/dtls_conn,
RFC 9147 sec 5-6): the one-round-trip full handshake (TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 / X25519 / Ed25519)
